summary: Faster W4A16 MoE prefill by skipping empty 16-row blocks
details: Large-M W4A16 route blocks issue the MMAs of a 16-row block only when it holds a live route; outputs are bit-identical.
GLM-5.3-Flash TP2 on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: MoE layer 1-8% faster at 1K-8K tokens, prefill +2.1-2.4% at 8K/32K, decode unchanged.
